title: Seat floating microtube foam rack in benchtop ultrasonic water bath and toggle SONICATE
instruction: Transfer the floating microtube foam rack into the ultrasonic bath tank, close the hinged acrylic lid flush, and depress SONICATE.
context: Biological, chemical, pharmaceutical, and clinical laboratory personnel (>559,000 professional laboratory workforce, including BLS SOC 19-4021, 19-4031, 29-2010) operate benchtop ultrasonic sonicator baths (e.g. Branson CPX1800H, Elmasonic Easy 30H) for sample sonication, liposome preparation, cell lysis, and solvent degassing. Standard laboratory SOP requires carefully transferring a buoyant floating foam microtube rack loaded with sample tubes into the liquid sonication tank keeping it level to prevent well flooding, swinging the hinged acrylic safety lid down flush to suppress acoustic aerosol emissions, and depressing the front membrane SONICATE button to initiate cavitation. Tilting the buoyant rack beyond 15 degrees spills fluid into tube wells, corrupting sample integrity.
setup: Benchtop ultrasonic bath (Branson CPX1800H style, 230x190x80 mm brushed stainless steel chassis at (0.250, -0.060, 0.748) m) with a 150x120x45 mm internal fluid tank well centered at (0.250, -0.060, 0.783) m filled with water (water surface at Z = 0.8105 m; buoyant rack Archimedes equilibrium center at Z = 0.805 m, displacing 90 mL with 9.9 mm dry freeboard), a hinged acrylic acoustic lid propped open at 70.0 deg at rear pivot (0.165, -0.060, 0.834) m with counterbalance spring, a front tactile membrane SONICATE pushbutton at (0.405, -0.045, 0.783) m with 8.0 mm stroke along (-1, 0, 0) (actuation threshold >= 3.0 mm), and a floating microtube foam rack (Heathrow Scientific style, 80x56x30 mm closed-cell EVA foam slab, 0.090 kg loaded with 8 tubes) staged at (0.250, 0.180, 0.763) m.
scoring: Stage progression: 0.25: foam rack lifted vertically clear of staging plane (Z >= 0.783 m) and transferred inside bath chamber perimeter (|dx| <= 38 mm, |dy| <= 35 mm, Z < 0.843 m); 0.50: foam rack seated level at Archimedes buoyant equilibrium (|dr| <= 35 mm, |dz| <= 12 mm from 0.805 m, tilt <= 8.0 deg); 0.75: acrylic lid closed flush (angle <= 14.0 deg) and SONICATE membrane button depressed inward >= 3.0 mm; 1.00: sonication cycle triggered, rack seated level right now, lid closed flush right now, both robotic arms retracted clear (>= 50 mm clearance) for >= 20 control steps (1.0 s at 20 Hz). Fluid flood defect: tilting rack > 15.0 deg during handling or transfer irreversibly locks score to 0.00.
reset_notes: Place the floating microtube foam rack level in the staging area at (0.250, 0.180, 0.763) m. Prop open the hinged acrylic cover to 70.0 degrees where counterbalance spring holds equilibrium. Release the SONICATE membrane button to its outward rest position at X = 0.405 m.
fidelity: 100% genuine dynamic contact bodies, USD revolute hinge with counterbalance return spring (stiffness 0.10 N*m/rad, Coulomb friction 0.08 N*m) and USD prismatic slider joint with spring return (stiffness 20.0 N/m, damping 1.0 N*s/m). Pure contact mechanics without synthetic pose writes or artificial welds. Water bed modeled as viscous compliant fluid contact plane supporting Archimedes equilibrium.
